title: STOP Stressing and Worrying: God Will Come Through (Christian Motivationl)
paragraphs: in our lives all of us at some point face feelings of stress and sadness it doesn't mean we're weak or being punished but even though stress is a part of life the truth is sometimes stress can be avoided so today I am here to show you how you can avoid unnecessary stress in your life I am also going to pray a powerful prayer with you calling on God to bless you abundantly in the name of Jesus so watch until the end

and open your heart to receive the blessings of this prayer the reality is life is full of challenges it's not just about facing these problems but also about staying close to God and finding inner peace even though everyone feels stressed sometimes some of these things can pull a Believer away from their faith it's important to spot these things and stay away from them this keeps our minds and bodies healthy and helps us connect better with God so today we'll talk about

10 things to avoid in order to live a less stressful life number one avoid worrying about tomorrow as we all know it worrying can cause a lot of stress in our life in The Sermon on the Mount Jesus addressed the concerns that naturally plague human Minds such as food clothing and life's uncertainties he asks us to look at the birds flying above and the flowers growing on the ground neither of them stores food in Barns or spins cloth but they're always

fed and dressed why because God takes care of them therefore I say to you do not worry about your life what you will eat or what you will drink nor about your body what you will put on is not life more than food and the body more than clothing look at the birds of the air for they neither sow nor reap nor gather into barns yet your heavenly father feeds them are you not of more value than they which of You

by worrying can add one cubit to his stature so why do you worry about clothing consider the lilies of the field how they grow they neither toil nor spin and yet I say to you that even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these now if God so closed the grass of the field which today is and tomorrow is thrown into the oven will he not much more clothe you or you of little faith therefore do not

worry saying what shall we eat or what shall we drink or what shall we wear for after all these things the Gentiles seek for your heavenly father knows that you need all these things but seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness and all these things shall be added to you therefore do not worry about tomorrow for tomorrow we'll worry about its own things sufficient for the day is its own trouble this was what Jesus told us in Matthew 6

verses 25 to 34 in these verses there's a deep message here for us if God looks after these small creatures and plants won't he look after us even more Jesus wants us to know that tomorrow has its own troubles and we should live for today trusting that God will provide instead of worrying about tomorrow we need to ensure that putting God first and living a Godly life is the priority in our lives then the blessings will follow if we truly believe

this we'll realize that there's no need to be overly anxious about the future or to stress about tomorrow the scripture reminds us to focus on today and let tomorrow take care of itself stay grounded in faith number two avoid worldly comparisons we live in a world that often tells us that more is better we sometimes look at our neighbors or friends and wish we had their life their job or their possessions but the Bible is clear comparing ourselves to others is

a path to unhappiness and stress the Ten Commandments given to Moses on Mount Sinai warns us against wanting what isn't ours Exodus 20 verse 17 says you shall not covet your neighbor's house you shall not covet your neighbor's wife for his male servant or his female servant or his ox or his donkey or anything that belongs to your neighbor but it's not just about wanting things second Corinthians 10 verse 12. mentions for we dare not class ourselves or compare ourselves with

those who commend themselves but they measuring themselves by themselves and comparing themselves among themselves are not wise this teaches us that looking at others and feeling jealous or Superior isn't the right way to live every person is unique in the eyes of God with their own journey and blessings so stop stressing about what others have or what others achieve we should be thankful for the blessings God has given us understanding that everyone's path is different and special in its own way

number three avoid bitterness and unforgiveness it's natural for people to get hurt and upset when someone does them wrong but holding on to these feelings for a long time can hurt our hearts and Minds it can cause a stress and anxiety the Bible gives us guidance on this too Ephesians 4 verses 31 to 32 states let all bitterness wrath anger clamor and evil speaking be put away from you with all malice and be kind to one another tenderhearted forgiving one another

even as God in Christ forgave you when we hold on to anger we let it control us but if we forgive we free ourselves from that weight from that stress it's like releasing a heavy burden we've been carrying around remembering how Jesus forgave those who wronged him even when he was on the cross should Inspire us to do the same holding on to bad feelings not only separates us from others but also from the love of God letting go of this

negativity and choosing forgiveness allows us to live a life of less stress we will feel lighter happier and closer to God's love number four avoid yielding to temptation when you yield to Temptation it can cause a lot of stress and problems in your life temptation is a challenge that everyone faces and giving in can stir feelings of guilt regret and a sense of drifting away from God's will the Bible acknowledges the very real struggles of Temptation but it also offers assurance

and guidance and First Corinthians 10 verse 13. it is written no temptation has overtaken you except such as is common to man but God is faithful who will not allow you to be tempted beyond what you are able but with the Temptation will also make the way of Escape that you may be able to Bear it this means that whatever challenges we Face they aren't unique to us alone many have faced them and overcome more importantly God provides a way out

a means of resistance so let us not ignore the way of Escape when we see it resist the devil he will flee from you the story of Jesus being tempted in the wilderness as recounted in the gospels provides an exemplary model he resisted the devil's temptations by quoting scripture demonstrating the power of God's word in helping us overcome when you resist the devil you will save yourself from the stress of sin number five avoid neglecting prayer and reading God's word a

life without fellowship with God is Not only destined for failure but it is also a setup for a journey full of the stresses of life communication with God through prayer and scripture reading is the lifeline for a believer it strengthens the spiritual core and provides Direction in times of uncertainty when we neglect this vital aspect of our faith we might feel distant from God and become more vulnerable to Life's challenges without his guidance we will give in more easily to worry

and stress Philippians 4 verses 6 to 7 States be anxious for nothing but in everything by prayer and supplication with Thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God and the peace of God which surpasses all understanding will guard your hearts and Minds through Christ Jesus this means that in any situation whether good or bad we should talk with God share our feelings and seek his counsel doing so ensures we remain grounded in our faith and enjoy the peace that comes

from being in God's presence we will enjoy a life of less stress and less to worry about number six avoid being unequally yoked this can be a challenging one to avoid but it is certainly one that causes much stress to many of us being unequally yoked isn't just about marriage but extends to any partnership where fundamental beliefs and values are misaligned in other words it means partnering with someone who doesn't share your values or beliefs making the relationship challenging in second

Corinthians 6 14 Paul advises do not be unequally yoked together with unbelievers for what Fellowship has righteousness with lawlessness and what communion has light with Darkness when individuals with different values come together it can create tension and stress as their foundational beliefs often guide their decisions and actions this is especially critical in spiritual matters in some cases even causing an unequal partnership to dilute your faith and commitment to God's principles however for those already in such situations the Bible offers hope

first it's essential to deepen your own relationship with God seeking his wisdom and guidance be a good example exemplifying christ-like Behavior which might influence the non-believing partner also continue to pray for them and Trust in God's transformative power to touch their heart remember God's love can bring about changes in the most unexpected ways number seven avoid seeking approval from the world every day Society broadcasts numerous messages about what we should value how we should look and how we should act these

messages however often don't align with God's teachings Galatians 1 verse 10 provides clear Direction on this it states for do I now persuade men or God or do I seek to please men for if I still please men I would not be a bond servant of Christ simply put if our main goal is to make people happy or to fit in with the world we might lose sight of what's truly important serving Christ and following his teachings the story of Daniel

serves as a great example despite being in a foreign land and Under Pressure to conform Daniel remained steadfast in his faith choosing to honor God over seeking approval from the Babylonian King so if you are one of these people quit trying to stress yourself about looking like those that we see on a magazine cover quit seeking approval from friends or loved ones try pleasing God instead he will never fail you number eight avoid idolatry in all forms idolatry isn't just about

bowing to statues or shrines it's about what we place at the center of our lives if we prioritize anything over God whether it's money Fame relationships or our Ambitions it becomes an idol prioritizing to the level of idolatry often leads to stress because these Idols can't provide the lasting fulfillment and peace that only comes from placing God at the center of our lives when we put our hope and trust in things that are temporary and unstable we're setting ourselves up for

disappointment worry and anxiety in contrast when we make God our ultimate priority we find a solid foundation that remains steady through life's ups and downs as Jesus said in Matthew 6 24 no one can serve two masters for either he will hate the one and love the other or else he will be loyal to the one and despise the other you cannot serve both God and Mammon the story of the golden calf in Exodus is a stark reminder even as Moses

was receiving the Commandments the Israelites in their impatience turned to worship a man-made Idol this later led to serious and stressful consequences number nine avoid negative speech and gossip negativity is in itself a breeding ground for stress and doubt words hold incredible power they can uplift or tear down heal or hurt as Believers the challenge is to harness this powerful good spreading words of encouragement love and truth Proverbs 18 verse 20 one reminds us death and life are in the power

of the tongue and those who love it will eat its fruit additionally James 3 verses 5 to 10. uses the metaphor of a small fire that sets a vast Forest Ablaze to describe how even a little gossip or negativity can cause extensive damage negativity and gossip can cause a lot of stress for yourself and others things like gossip slander and harmful words can break bonds and Destroy Unity by being mindful of our words we can be a source of comfort and

light to others and to ourselves and number 10 avoid fear and embrace Faith fear can be a powerful emotion that grips us and holds us back from living life to the fullest it's natural to feel fear when facing uncertainty or challenging situations however the Bible encourages us to trust in God and not to be overcome by fear the scripture also reminds us that God is always with us and supports Us in times of need one of the most reassuring verses that

highlight this message is Isaiah 41 verse 10. so do not fear for I Am With You do not be dismayed for I am your God this verse shows that God understands the fears anxieties and stress that we face in our lives he is telling us that we do not need to be afraid or distressed because he is with us ready to strengthen and help us In this passage God is making a commitment to support and comfort us this should encourage us

to overcome our fears and trust in God the story of David and Goliath also shows the power of Faith over fear David a young Shepherd boy faced Goliath a fearsome Giant Warrior everyone else was terrified but David had faith in God he confidently proclaimed in first Samuel 17 45 I come to you in the name of the Lord of hosts the god of the armies of Israel whom you have defined David's faith in God empowered him to overcome his fear and

defeat Goliath showing that faith can conquer even the most dangerous enemies when we allow fear and stress to control Our Lives we may miss out on opportunities to grow learn and experience God's blessings by embracing faith and trusting in God we can find strength and courage to face life's challenges with confidence this attitude aligns us with God's plan for our lives and allows us to experience the fullness of his love and support so let's choose to embrace faith and trust in

God's presence and support with God by our side we can overcome fear and stress and live life with confidence and hope life is full of ups and downs and if we are honest about it sometimes it's the choices we make that add extra stress when we spend too much time trying to fit in or seeking approval from others we might lose sight of who we truly are and what's truly important it's the same when we let things like money or objects

become the center of our world they can take us away from the deeper connections and meanings in life and speaking badly about others or joining in on Gossip doesn't just hurt those we talk about it hurts us too making our hearts heavy and clouding our minds with negativity every choice we make has a ripple effect shaping our days our relationships and our overall well-being remember lasting happiness doesn't come from external validation or material possessions but from the peace and contentment found

within when we prioritize genuine relationships uphold our values seek wisdom from God in our decisions we pave the way for a more balanced and joyful life it's therefore essential to regularly reflect on our choices ensuring they align with God's purpose and plan for us also consider that our spiritual journey isn't just about following a set of rules it's about cultivating a deep personal relationship with the Creator one that guides and nurtures us through life's twists and turns stay rooted in your

faith stop stressing and embrace the peace hope and love that God offers now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to our gracious and loving God Heavenly Father Mighty and eternal God you are the source of every good and perfect thing Lord I exalt and honor you for being my

refuge in times of trouble and my strength in moments of weakness in the mighty name of Jesus I declare that I will not be consumed by the worries of tomorrow knowing your hand guides my every step I rebuke the spirit of comparison choosing to embrace the unique blessings and journey you've set for me Lord cleanse my heart from bitterness and unforgiveness Let Your Love overflow enabling me to release and forgive as you have done for me father I reject and resist

every form of Temptation declaring victory over them by your grace Lord I commit to prioritizing time with you through prayer and meditating on your word embracing your strength and wisdom I rebuke every urge to form unequal Yokes that deviate from your perfect will ensuring my relationships align with your Divine Purpose in the name of Jesus I denounce the need for worldly approval fixing my eyes solely on your validation I reject every form of idolatry recognizing that in my life nothing is

worthy of being placed above you Lord help me to guard my tongue preventing it from spreading negativity or engaging in Gossip but rather let it be a tool of encouragement and love I declare that fear has no hold over me as I put my faith and trust in you Fill Me Lord with Abundant Blessings in all areas of my life may you also bless me with your peace joy and love father I pray that my loved ones will come to experience

your grace and goodness so that they too will experience your peace which surpasses all understanding Lord as I say this prayer together with everyone listening I am grateful for all the hearts that are opening to you right now I pray that a Divine understanding will surround us making us resilient against the stresses that the world throws at us and steadfast in the joy and hope that comes only from you Lord may you comfort us through your holy spirit thank you Lord

for hearing and answering my prayer in the name of Jesus I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comment section below I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member who you know need the blessing of this prayer and by

clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all those who support us you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comments section so that we can present them before God for your blessings and victory also we invite other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you right now

and we want you to know that even if you don't see a reply to your prayer request it doesn't mean that you were not prayed for rest assured that we are actively lifting up each request to God that is in accordance with his will we believe in the power of prayer to bring Comfort healing and guidance in accordance with God's perfect plan stand in faith with us while we pray to God be all the glory May the grace and peace of
our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all
